items.title: Alton Purnell Interview, 1968-03-03
items.q: The only difference in the band is that the one in English boy, Keith Smith, is playing trumpet on it.

ctx.x: Who you got with you on it?
Well, almost the same band, just about the same band. The only difference in the band is that the one in English boy, Keith Smith, is playing trumpet on it.
Those English boys play a mighty fine hunk of jazz sometimes.
